en.io: Takes system boot triggers and configurations as inputs and outputs validation status results and Git persistence records.
en.boundary: Focuses solely on boot sequence verification and state tracking, and does not perform physical system installation or hardware repair.
scenarios: Validating auto-boot sequences during system startup or recovery.
Testing system resilience and boot integrity under degraded or offline conditions.
Tracking autopoietic feedback loops and validation logs using Git as a database.

zh.io: 输入系统引导触发指令与配置参数，输出验证状态结果及存入 Git 的状态记录。
zh.boundary: 仅专注于引导序列校验与状态记录，不负责系统重装或硬件级别的修缮。
scenarios: 在系统启动或恢复阶段验证自动引导序列。
在离线或服务降级环境下测试系统的引导韧性与状态完整性。
利用 Git 记录自生反馈循环与引导验证日志。
